title: Article: How Dimension Influences Success and Wealth in Life

segments.text: We already know that a person’s dimension plays a major role in determining how luxurious and successful his life will be in the physical world. However, this also makes him a target for jealousy, grudges, and negative energy from others.

If a person’s dimension keeps decreasing , then no matter how hard he work, his efforts will go to waste . Even if his birth chart shows that he is destined to be wealthy and successful, he might struggle financially and fail to achieve his goals .

When a person is born, his birth chart is created based on the planetary positions at that time. But these positions are linked to the dimension he was born in. If his dimension drops over time , his reality no longer aligns with his birth chart predictions .

For example, imagine someone born into a rich family with a birth chart indicating massive success. However, due to continuous negative energy from jealous people , his dimension keeps decreasing . As a result, despite all efforts, he struggle financially, face constant obstacles, and fail to achieve the success he was meant to have .

A high dimension attracts success , while a falling dimension leads to struggles . To maintain wealth, prosperity, and success, one must protect his dimension from negative influences and continuously work to increase it !
Measuring a Person’s Dimension: Unlocking the Scale of Physical and Astral Growth
Our Guru tattva has provided a special scale to our Bhaiya for measuring dimensions. Based on this reference, the average person has a dimension of around 50,000 .
However, it’s crucial to understand that there are two types of dimensions :
Physical Dimension – This influences a person’s appearance, personality, and physical presence . A higher physical dimension means a person may look more attractive, confident, and charismatic .

Astral Dimension – This determines how protected a person is from astral influences , such as black magic, evil eye, and negativity . The higher the astral dimension, the less affected a person is by these forces.
While physical dimension shapes outer beauty , astral dimension defines inner strength and protection . Understanding both is essential for true spiritual and worldly success !
Note: The astral dimension cannot be increased by raising the physical dimension. However, when the astral dimension increases, the physical dimension naturally rises as well.
